features.feature: Wide three-seat sofa upholstered throughout in mottled coco-brown/taupe fabric.
Two large rectangular back cushions, each with a horizontal stitched seam across its lower portion.
Broad seat cushion with a vertical center seam.
Padded arms that angle outward, with visible vertical seams along their front edges.

features.where: Under the sofa at the corners

photoBackdrop: A warm-toned room with a curved yellow-and-rose staircase, cream walls, globe pendant lights, a yellow rug, and small tables with an orange rotary telephone.
